senses.gloss:
लिग्(इ)लिगि r. 1st cl. (लिङ्गति) To go, to move. r. 1st and 10th cls.
(लिङ्गति लिङ्गयति-ते) To paint, to variegate. With आङ् To embrace.

लिगु n. (-गु)
 1. The heart, the mind.
 m. (-गुः)
 1. A fool, a blockhead.
2. A deer.
 3. Part of the earth.
 E. लग् to be near or with, Unādi
aff. कु, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
